name: Emily's Hotel Solitaire 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Emily's Hotel Solitaire is a puzzle game where you embark on a tropical adventure with Emily, and fulfill her grandfather's dream of building the best hotel in the world! Immerse yourself in the magical atmosphere as you enjoy the challenging games of Solitaire and create your luxurious hotel paradise.
